priorBounds.basis: An earlier same-runner dated result still has a slower personal best; the later screenshot has this intermediate previous best. Both bounding evidence days agree. Publication clock is not treated as the exact finish time.

decision: Withdraw unsupported same-day lower bound; exact achievement day and absolute bounds unknown. Preserve relative performance order and later observation.
limitations: No fresh pixels read. Caption and existing review do not identify capture date; post clock only proves publication.
This removes an inference, not the previous-best result. Exact date recovery still requires original evidence and source coverage.
